# One Lua pattern per line, matched against "<healthcheck> | <WARNING|ERROR> <message>".
# Only environment noise of a CI runner belongs here, never a real config problem.

# Mason optional toolchains. Packages that need them are skipped, and the config installs none that do.
^mason | WARNING luarocks: not available
^mason | WARNING wget: not available
^mason | WARNING Composer: not available
^mason | WARNING PHP: not available
^mason | WARNING Ruby: not available
^mason | WARNING RubyGem: not available
^mason | WARNING javac: not available
^mason | WARNING java: not available
^mason | WARNING julia: not available

# Headless runner without a display server or session clipboard.
^vim.provider | WARNING No clipboard tool found

# The runner has no inotify-tools and Neovim cannot do anything about that from config.
^vim.lsp | WARNING libuv%-watchdirs has known performance issues

# Headless run: TERM is unset, so `infocmp -L` fails.
^vim.health | ERROR command failed: { "infocmp", "%-L" }

# cmp.lua builds jsregexp only outside Windows on purpose; LSP snippet transformations are unavailable there.
^luasnip | WARNING For Variable/Placeholder%-transformations, luasnip requires
